Package com.sca4d.core.spring.setting

Class SettingRepository

java.lang.Object
com.sca4d.core.spring.setting.SettingRepository
public class SettingRepository extends Object
隔离 Settings 对 MyBatis、影响行数、条件写入和初始化锁 SQL 的依赖。
